messages:
maria: Heads-up: billing spike flagged for tenant-900, +12% vs forecast. Correlates with long-lived streaming sessions that call tools.

jon: I pulled the raw ingest and found duplicate billing events for the same request_id but different window_keys and offsets.

lucas: that's the classic window-split problem. Our current aggregator groups by (tenant,window_key) and emits whatever it sees per-window.

tara: sample pair? paste (redacted) so we can see fields.

maria: pasted snippet: 
```json
{"request_id":"r-bleu-77","tenant":"tenant-900","seq":0,"tokens":400,"offset":"o:324","window":"2026-03-22T14:10:00Z"}
{"request_id":"r-bleu-77","tenant":"tenant-900","seq":1,"tokens":360,"offset":"o:329","window":"2026-03-22T14:11:00Z"}
```

jon: two partials for the same request. Downstream accounting summed them both.

lucas: Options I see: (A) change SDK to emit final_marker so aggregator can close request; (B) aggregator keeps per-request state keyed by request_id+tenant until TTL then emits canonical row; (C) move to append-only raw topic + consolidation worker that emits one canonical ledger entry per request (recommended for auditability).

nate: quick notes on tradeoffs: A is lowest infra but breaks SDKs and requires rollout. B is low-latency but requires more memory/coordination in the aggregator. C adds infra and a bit of latency but gives a single source-of-truth and simpler downstreams.

ops-bot: :gear: deploy started billing-aggregator/patch-2026-03-22 @4159999010

tara: audits matter — we need deterministic canonical rows with provenance (source offsets, first/last offsets seen). Heuristic merges are risky for disputes.

maria: leaning towards C (consolidator) + hybrid SDK opt-in. Reason: we preserve compatibility, give ops a provable ledger, and can transition billing consumers to canonical_ledger once stable.

j on: (typo) jon: agreed on hybrid. Implementation sketch: write a consolidator that consumes raw_events topic, groups by request_id, replays chunks until final_marker or watermark TTL, then emits canonical_event:{request_id,tenant,total_tokens,chunks,first_offset,last_offset,first_seen_ts,finalized_ts}. Put dedupe_key = sha256(request_id || first_offset). Make writes idempotent using dedupe_key as primary key in ledger store.

lucas: consolidator should also emit provenance: list of source offsets (or offset-range) so we can trace back a canonical row to raw offsets for audits. That needs efficient storage; maybe store a compressed range or start+end offsets and count.

nate: TTL question: what latency can we accept before billing sees the canonical row? If we require near real-time (<5s) that's tough. Proposal: pipeline with two modes: realtime-path (current aggregator emits best-effort windowed events for live dashboards) and canonical-path (canonical ledger emits authoritative rows with a small lag, e.g., 2 minutes). Billing settles on canonical_path.

tara: rollback/backfill plan: run consolidation in replay mode for last 90 days for top-250 tenants (by spend) and compare counts to existing billing. Produce delta report and attach to tickets for any tenant >1% delta. Sample the long tail.

maria: SDK plan: add optional final_marker + seq_number to streaming SDKs. Make it opt-in v1; aggregator accepts but doesn't require. Publish migration doc for partners. We'll avoid breaking changes.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: deploy finished billing-aggregator/patch-2026-03-22 @4159999030

jon: tests: unit tests for consolidator (out-of-order chunks, missing final_marker, duplicate chunks), integration test that canonical_ledger is idempotent under restarts, chaos test that replays offsets duplicate times.

lucas: metrics to instrument: percent_of_requests_with_final_marker, duplicate_event_rate_by_request, canonicalization_latency_p50/p99, reconciler_delta_per_tenant. Dashboards + alert when reconciler delta > threshold for top tenants.

nate: storage: canonical ledger can be a compacted Kafka topic keyed by request_id; consumers (billing) can read committed compacted view. Complement with materialized view in DB for fast queries during disputes.

tara: legal/audit ask: attach provenance + recon report export tool so we can hand a trace to finance for billing disputes. Include checksums and offsets.

maria: concrete next steps: Lucas prototypes consolidator (stream-first pass) + dedupe semantics, Jon builds integration tests + replay harness, Tara drafts backfill sampling plan for top tenants, Nate drafts SDK opt-in notes. Sophia from product looped in for customer comms.

maria: timeline: prototype in 1 week, small canary run for 48h on subset of tenants, then backfill sample for last 30 days. Full rollout conditional on reconciler delta <0.5% for sample.

ops-bot: :loudspeaker: canary started consolidator/canary @4159999050

maria: thanks team. Keep the canonicalization deterministic and provable. If we can get provenance + idempotent writes, billing disputes should be much easier to resolve. :thumbsup:
